name: Clock & Timeline Simulator
description: Simulation engine for time concepts: elapsed time, starting & finishing times, crossing noon/midnight, and hour-to-minute conversions across the 5-stage mastery model.
author: TezMindz Olympiad Team

stages.name: Concept Discovery
stages.focus: Manipulate clock hands, observe minute-to-hour ratio, discover 60 mins = 1 full rotation

stages.name: Guided Simulation
stages.focus: Goal-driven timeline navigation with 4-step progressive hints

stages.name: Rule Discovery
stages.focus: Expressing the elapsed time formula before formal vocabulary

stages.name: Controlled Practice
stages.focus: Parameterized dynamic variations (varying durations, crossing noon/midnight)

stages.name: Anti-Memorisation Assessment
stages.focus: Unseen word problems without visual manipulative assistance

progressiveHints.description: 4-tier hints: 1. Attention pointer, 2. Next reasoning step, 3. Demonstration step, 4. Full solution

sampleData.prompt: An Olympiad inter-school marathon commenced at 10:45 AM and concluded at 01:20 PM. Calculate the total elapsed time.
sampleData.subPrompt: Drag the interactive minute hand or use the +15 min / +1 hour buttons to bridge across 12:00 Noon.
discoveryGuidingQuestions: What happens to the hour hand when the minute hand completes 1 full rotation (60 minutes)?
When moving from 11:59 AM to 12:00, what happens to the AM/PM designation?
Can we break 10:45 AM to 01:20 PM into two jumps: (10:45 AM to 12:00 Noon) and (12:00 Noon to 01:20 PM)?
progressiveHints: Level 1 (Attention): Focus on the bridge hour: 12:00 Noon.
Level 2 (Reasoning): How many minutes from 10:45 AM to 12:00 Noon? (15 mins to 11:00 AM + 60 mins = 75 minutes = 1 hr 15 mins).
Level 3 (Demonstration): Next add the time from 12:00 Noon to 01:20 PM, which is 1 hour 20 minutes.
Level 4 (Full Solution): 1 hr 15 mins + 1 hr 20 mins = 2 hours 35 minutes.

ruleDiscovery.statementPrompt: Complete the rule for calculating elapsed time crossing noon:
ruleOptions: Elapsed Time = (Time to 12:00 Noon) + (Time past 12:00 Noon)
Elapsed Time = Finish Time minus Start Time ignoring AM/PM
Elapsed Time = Always multiply hours by 60 and add seconds
ruleDiscovery.correctRule: Elapsed Time = (Time to 12:00 Noon) + (Time past 12:00 Noon)

sampleData.explanation: Jump 1: 10:45 AM to 12:00 PM = 1 hour 15 minutes. Jump 2: 12:00 PM to 01:20 PM = 1 hour 20 minutes. Total = 2 hours 35 minutes.
